description: idle: breathes slowly, the chest and shoulders rise and fall slightly, the head tilts a little and he blinks once, the hand holding the microphone drifts a few pixels and back; the stretched right arm and open hand stay perfectly still; then settles back into the starting pose. The background and everything except the host stay absolutely identical in every frame, pixel-locked: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no flicker, no color shift; the red lacquer panels, gold trim, bulb arch, screen and counter do not move at all.
subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, unnaturally white made-up face, large completely black eyes, holding a microphone, in front of an arch of unlit bulbs
initial_pose: turned three-quarters to the right, leaning forward, closed-lip smile, microphone in his left hand near his chest, right arm stretched down to the right with the open palm beside a turntable
